source.indexConvention: 0-based Word body-block index shown in [n], including tables; not page numbers.

authority: Original Word text and supplied figures are authoritative. Later plans/checklists only verify; they cannot simplify or remove original scope. Explicit user amendment on 2026-10-01 takes precedence for language: target Chinese market, default Simplified Chinese with an in-app English switch; all other original requirements remain.
overall: PARTIAL_ORIGINAL_CONFORMANCE — playable demo plus corrected client implementation; not frozen-reference acceptance or App Store release.
method: Grouped substantive requirements across chapters 1–8. Observation-only prose, repeated illustrations and summary tables are not counted as separate acceptance items. Status is per stated evidence scope, not a completion percentage.

statusDefinitions.implemented: Code is present and inspected; no claim of full current-build acceptance.
statusDefinitions.verified: The specifically described behavior has current scoped verification evidence; remaining limitations still apply.
statusDefinitions.awaiting_reference: Frozen reference values/assets/corpus needed for this requirement are absent; local defaults cannot substitute.
statusDefinitions.external_pending: External SDK/services/publisher/release inputs or integration are outstanding; this does not remove client-side work.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some required behavior, integration, verification or source alignment remains incomplete.

evidenceLimitations: 旧88项Checklist的完成数字与originalRequirementsPreserved标志不作为原文符合性证据；旧版报告只保留历史。
当前150+30严格生产完成，180唯一答案及不同区域结构，无相似性豁免；数值Profile仍未经Pawdoku校准，跨产品语料缺失。
原文只固定L1为4×4；本地早期尺寸安排不能覆盖原文的去重要求。
0.2.1主页面与0.2.4反馈组件图册保留原版本；0.2.7另有25张实际宿主页面截图，两设备核对结算、礼盒和8×8进度。页面级Reduce Motion注入不代表系统全局验收，缺冻结录屏时不声称逐帧一致。
真实广告SDK由外部供应；客户端入口、配置、库存、复活和奖励安全仍是本Demo责任。
Daily Challenge保留锁定入口，Profile明确不做。真机局域网安装0.2.21（24）及用户信任后的手动启动已确认，并核实运行进程；正式原音频、真实SDK、完整真机游玩与专项回归及上架仍待验。
0.2.11启动图册来自两设备实际宿主页面；大字与Reduce Motion为视图测试配置，14张最终截图不代表真机、系统读屏或原版逐帧时序验收。
2026-10-01用户明确中文市场要求，覆盖原文英文界面条款。0.2.12默认简体中文并支持英文切换；历史英文截图和88条首轮验收仍保留原版本。
0.2.14的151+临时Profile v2与0.2.1历史180关证据分别保存。新60关为151–180及容量压力下291–320，未生成181–290，也不证明无限生成或正式难度对标。

rows.title: 提示仅预览，Apply 应用，关闭不改盘
